feature: Ask adds a recording from History and cuts where something happens
summary: On a video, Ask can now put a recording from History on the timeline, and can look at the video's frames to find a moment by what happens in it, then cut there and put a transition on the cut.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Ask's built-in model downloaded. History holding at least one recording.

try.do: Open a screen recording and press Ask in the title bar.
Type: put my latest recording after this one, and press Return.
Check the timeline: your newest recording sits on V1 straight after the open clip, and newer screenshots in History were skipped.
Press Command Z once: the added clip comes back off.
Ask again: cut this clip where <something on screen> starts and put a dissolve across the cut.
Scrub across the cut: it lands on the first frame that shows the change, with a dissolve on it.

evaluate: Did Ask pick the recording you meant by 'latest', skipping newer screenshots?
Did the cut land on the moment you described, within a few frames?
Is the extra wait while Ask looks at the frames (about half a minute to two minutes) acceptable for a request like this?
Would you expect Ask to say which recording it added, by name, in its row?
rough: No mock covers Ask's video requests; the row in the Agent group reads as any other Ask change ('Added a clip').
The second picture is the eval's contact sheet of the result (cut at 2.0 s, 0.4 s dissolve), not a window capture; the walk photographs only the History request.
Finding a moment needs a model that sees. With a model that cannot see pictures, Ask is not offered the frames and still answers that it cannot find the moment.

The eval scores the History case 67.9 to 75.8 across three runs: the judge marks it down because the eval's History recording is the same footage as the open clip, which reads as a repeat. Ask's result is right every time (rules 10 of 10).
